newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia central bank cuts discount rates - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia central bank cuts discount rates - dealers.

text.p: Indonesia's central bank, Bank Indonesia, cut its key discount rate for short-term securities (SBPUs) by 50 basis points on Wednesday, dealers said.
"The central bank has cut discount rates by 50 basis points for all maturities on Wednesday," one state bank dealer said.
The dealer said one week-money fell to 14.75 percent, two to 15.0 percent, and one month to 15.50 percent.
This was confirmed by the central bank.
SBPUs are papers purchased by the central bank to inject liquidity into the banking system.
Another dealer said the SBPU cut was seen as a signal from the central bank that interest rates were expected to be on a downward trend in the future.
